verdict.rationale: Aider's own docs say you can add images to the chat as visual context, such as screenshots. It also edits HTML, CSS and JavaScript, so an image-informed build is plausible. Nothing documents or demonstrates turning a sketch or design into a working app, and PDFs are not mentioned. Missing for 10: PDF design input, a documented design-to-app workflow, hands-on evidence that the generated app works.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design

citations.quote: Add images and web pages to the chat to provide visual context, screenshots, reference docs, etc.
Aider works with most popular programming languages: python, javascript, rust, ruby, go, cpp, php, html, css, and dozens more.
